### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-analytics`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

**20** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f7c545ad8cc34481caf5def21dc673bbd916f46d`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f7c545ad8cc34481caf5def21dc673bbd916f46d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f411379b3e1d2f250d7138439e0113dace66d3dc` — the merge of head `80559b2cabf41f12e05b97b6b67254eb15774fa5` into base `f7c545ad8cc34481caf5def21dc673bbd916f46d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f411379b3e1d2f250d7138439e0113dace66d3dc && git checkout f411379b3e1d2f250d7138439e0113dace66d3dc
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f7c545ad8cc34481caf5def21dc673bbd916f46d 80559b2cabf41f12e05b97b6b67254eb15774fa5 && git checkout -B drift-repro f7c545ad8cc34481caf5def21dc673bbd916f46d && git merge --no-ff 80559b2cabf41f12e05b97b6b67254eb15774fa5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f7c545ad8cc34481caf5def21dc673bbd916f46d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f7c545ad8cc34481caf5def21dc673bbd916f46d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `80559b2cabf41f12e05b97b6b67254eb15774fa5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-date-bucket-door.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/preview-date-bucket-type.test.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/objectql-echo-column-twice.test.ts, packages/client/src/envelope-caller-census.test.ts + .changeset/28852-preview-refuses-date-bucket-over-non-date.md (prose), packages/objectql/src/aggregate-query-shape-door.ts, packages/objectql/src/having-filter.ts (classOfDeclaredType), packages/objectql/src/engine.ts (the aggregate door order), packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-group-column-door.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-evaluator.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts (sourceFieldMeta), packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts (canHandle), packages/services/service-analytics/src/index.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/package.json, docs/adr/0037-live-canvas-draft-preview.md

Reviewed on PR #28976 for card #28852, net diff of `80559b2c` against its merge-base `9a9823d9` with `main` (7 files: +316 / -11). `main` has moved since the merge-base (`fed3a51b` at review time); `git diff --stat` between the merge-base and `main` over `packages/services/service-analytics`, `packages/objectql/src/aggregate-query-shape-door.ts` and the client census file is empty, so every judgment below holds against `main` as it stands. Read-only: refs fetched, `git show` / `git diff`, card and PR via `gh api` REST, check-runs via REST. Inputs: the card body and its three comments (triage 6566450228, claim 6568806407, os-dev-report 6569764928), the PR body, file list and net diff, the head's check-runs, and the cited sibling record 6567726005 / 6568525192 on PR #28878 for the should-fix the ride-along closes. Time of record: 2026-11-02T05:36Z.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The accept set of `queryDataset` with `previewDrafts: true` (over a pending seed) narrows.** A selection whose group keys carry `{ field, dateGranularity }` over a field the object declares with a type that is not `formula` and is neither a `date` (`CALENDAR_DATE_TYPES`) nor a `datetime` (`INSTANT_TYPES`) is refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 / `httpStatus` 400 with `object`, `param: 'groupBy'`, `path: groupBy.N.dateGranularity`, `field`, `fields: [field]` and the engine's message. **Right.** It is the card's Wanted 2 and the claim ruling: the engine's `assertDateBucketTargetsAreTemporal` (`packages/objectql/src/aggregate-query-shape-door.ts:95-123`) skips exactly `cls === undefined` (no field map, no such field, no string type, or `formula`, per `classOfDeclaredType` in `having-filter.ts:1150-1159`) and `date` / `datetime`; every other declared type (`text`, `select`, `number`, `boolean`, `time`, `lookup`, `currency`, and so on) is classed and refused there. The preview door's `type === undefined || type === 'formula' || CALENDAR_DATE_TYPES.has(type) || INSTANT_TYPES.has(type)` is the same predicate over the same spec sets, so the two readings coincide for every declared type.
2. **The refusal is the live faces' refusal, field for field.** `object`: the engine's is the aggregate's object name, which the strategy passes as `extractObjectName(cube)` = `aggregateObjectOf(cube)` = `cube.sql.trim()`, and a compiled dataset's cube has `sql: dataset.object` (`dataset-compiler.ts:888`); the preview passes `aggregateObjectOf(cube)` and reads the type with `this.sourceFieldMeta?.(dataset.object, field)`, which is the same object. The type: the engine reads `this._registry.getObject(object).fields[field].type` (`engine.ts:21236`); `sourceFieldMeta` reads `dataEngine().getObject(object).fields[field].type` (`plugin.ts:1437-1443`), and `ObjectQL.getObject` is `getSchema` is `this._registry.getObject` (`engine.ts:22026`, `11835`): one registry. The keys and positions: `aggregateGroupKeys(q, cube)` is the `groupBy` the strategy's direct path hands the engine (`objectql-strategy.ts:326`), the same reader the preview's column-twice door already judges on. The message is built from `object`, `path`, `field`, `dateGranularity` and `type`, verbatim from the engine's. **Right**, and pinned on three faces by `preview-date-bucket-type.test.ts` (four types, the later position `groupBy.2`, two served controls).
3. **Every live face reaches the engine door.** `NativeSQLStrategy.canHandle` declines any `timeDimensions[].granularity` (`native-sql-strategy.ts:645`), so native and ObjectQL alike hand the bucket to `ObjectQLStrategy.execute` and then `engine.aggregate`, where the temporal door sits. The cross-object path cannot carry a preview selection: `assertPreviewJoinsNothing` refuses any relationship path earlier in the list, so the direct path's keys are the only ones a preview selection can reach. **Right.**
4. **Order in the preview gate list.** The new call runs last, after `assertDatasetGroupColumnsDistinct`, as on the live faces, where the strategy's dataset door runs right before `engine.aggregate` and the engine's temporal door runs inside it. In the engine the temporal door runs after the structured-JSON group door and the aggregate × field-type door (`engine.ts:21225-21237`); the preview list runs `assertDimensionsGroupScalarColumns` and `assertMeasureFieldTypes` well before the new call, so a `json` field under a bucket keeps the JSON door's words on every face. **Right.**
5. **The granularity the door sees is the one every face buckets by.** `DatasetExecutor` resolves the effective granularity (stated, then `selection.dateGranularity`, then the dataset dimension's `dateGranularity`, `resolveDimensionGranularity`, `dataset-executor.ts:395-407`) into the query it issues to `previewService.query` and to the live `query()` alike, so `withDeclaredGranularityDefaults` (which only `query()` / `generateSql()` run) is a no-op on a dataset query, and a dataset dimension declared `type: 'date'` with a default `dateGranularity` over a text column is bucketed and now refused on every face. **Right** (follows from the cited code; not pinned, see ④).
6. **Ride-along in `ObjectQLStrategy.generateSql`.** `declaredDateColumn` and `this.dateRangeBounds(cube, query, echoDateColumn)` move from the window-render loop to before `assertDatasetGroupColumnsDistinct`; the loop renders the same array (`for (const { member, bounds } of windows)`). `dateRangeBounds` takes no `params` and pushes nothing, so the rendered statement and its parameter order are byte-identical for every served selection; what changes is only which of two 400 refusals a doubly-wrong body gets: an unrecognised preset string (`resolveAnalyticsDateRangeString`) or a malformed array (`explicitDateRangeWindow`, `date-range-array-arm.ts:118-125`) now answers `ANALYTICS_DATE_RANGE_UNRECOGNIZED` before the column refusal, as `execute()` does (its `dateRangeBounds` at `objectql-strategy.ts:493` precedes its door at `:562`). **Right.** It closes the should-fix of record 6567726005 (PR #28878). Residual, not widened by this diff: `execute()` reads the windows before `planCrossObject` and the echo reads them after it, so a body carrying both a bad `dateRange` and an out-of-envelope cross-object reference still answers the plan refusal on the echo and the window refusal on the query. Pre-existing; noted for the seat, not a finding on this diff.
7. **No public surface widens.** `packages/services/service-analytics/src/index.ts` is untouched and exports neither door; `preview-date-bucket-door.ts` is imported by `analytics-service.ts` alone; its only strategy import is `import type { AggregateGroupKey }`, as the sibling door's; no error code, status, answer member or query key is added; `packages/objectql` and `packages/spec` are untouched; `@objectstack/objectql` stays a devDependency of the package (`package.json`), and its root does not export the engine door (`packages/objectql/src/index.ts` names neither the module nor the function), so the copy of the sentence is the only way to the same refusal without a dependency or export change, which the card forbids (「⛔ No new gate on the live faces」, no `packages/objectql` change). **Right.**
8. **Census.** `envelope-caller-census.test.ts` excludes `queryDataset` by design (its header line 24 and §4, `METHODS` lists `analytics.query`, `meta`, `explain`, `automation.trigger`), so the new preview test, which calls only `queryDataset`, contributes no site; `generateSql` is not censused either. `objectql-echo-column-twice.test.ts` gains exactly one textual `analytics.query(` site (the new `it.each`'s `refusalOf('query', analytics.query(...))`), so the ledger row 3 → 4, the service sites 14 → 15 and `NOT_SDK` 14 → 15 are right, and the file is already declared as a `@objectstack/client#test` input (`scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs:863`, `turbo.json:346`). The new test file imports only workspace packages and reads no file outside its package, so it needs no declaration. **Right.**
9. **Changeset.** `@objectstack/service-analytics` `patch`, `fix(...)!` title, BREAKING paragraph, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, one `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker (a category the gate lists, `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:557`), remedy stated, the ride-along named. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/service-analytics` matches what the diff publishes: no spec key, no export, no type at the package root changes; one face's accept set narrows, which is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` with the BREAKING banner (Post-Task Checklist 3: a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` with its banner and ADR-0087 disposition). The PR body and the changeset both carry `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` as line-initial declarations, and both are right: nothing a metadata author writes is added, refused or re-meant, and the dataset spec (`DatasetDimension.dateGranularity`, "Default bucketing for date dimensions") is untouched. `Skills-docs: none` holds: under `content/docs` the `previewDrafts` mentions are the metadata read doors (`references/api/protocol.mdx`), the `validate()` preview (`data-modeling/currency.mdx:336`) and release notes; nothing under `content/docs` or `skills/**` says the draft preview serves a date bucket over a non-date column.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev deviation 1 (a new module beside the one-line call; the claim names `analytics-service.ts`).** Answered: the claim's file surface names the gate list, and the module sits as `dataset-group-column-door.ts` sits (same header shape, same type-only import, same non-export); the gate-list call is the one line the card asked for. Accepted.
- **Dev deviation 2 (census 14 → 15; no test-input change).** Answered in ① item 8. Accepted.
- **Dev deviation 3 (C3, the `formula` skip, stays green).** Answered: the arm mirrors `classOfDeclaredType`, which returns no class for `formula`, so the engine does not judge one either; the preview's skip is the parity arm, not a widening. Unpinned, stated; see ④ should-fix 2. Accepted.
- **Dev deviation 4 (squashed and rebased onto `9a9823d9`; `main` moved 8 commits before the push, now 13).** Answered: no commit between the merge-base and `main` touches a path of this diff or a cited file. Accepted.
- **Dev deviation 5 (branch recreated after #28878 merged; PR opened with no labels).** No rule bears on it; the PR now carries `needs:contract-review` and is a draft. Accepted.
- **`open_questions`: empty.** Nothing to answer.
- **Out-of-scope finding (the `/analytics/sql` echo renders `strftime` over a non-date column where the query refuses).** Read in the live tree: `generateSql` renders every bucketed dimension through `dimExpr` after its doors, and no door of the echo reads the field's type, so the finding holds. Same family as #28841; **escalated to the seat to file as its own card**, not touched here and not a verdict on this diff (the card said ⛔ no new gate on the live faces).
- **Card's Wanted 2, "reuse the engine's field-type reading or an existing service-analytics reading of it rather than a third copy".** The type reading is `sourceFieldMeta` (the reader the evaluator already types rows by) classed by the spec's own sets, the same sets the engine reads: no third copy of the reading. The refusal sentence is a second copy (engine, preview), pinned field for field against both live faces, so a drift in the engine's wording reds the test. Accepted.
- **Identity.** The PR head branch `claude/project-thread-0o422x` matches the claim (6568806407); the os-dev-report (6569764928) names this head; no model identifier in the title, body, changeset or code comments.

### ④ Design judgment

Read against the published spec on `main`: the contract's `queryDataset` option (`packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts:410-414`) says `previewDrafts` "evaluates the selection over the base object's PENDING seed-draft rows ... so a draft preview charts real numbers before publish"; ADR-0037 states the design center as "what you see is exactly what Publish will make real" and the Phase 3 acceptance as "after Publish the same widgets show the same numbers from real tables". No spec text declares that a non-date field can be date-bucketed anywhere; `DatasetDimension.dateGranularity` is "Default bucketing for date dimensions", and the engine door's header (#25818) names the served `null` bucket "a plausible table under 200". The narrowing takes no declared capability away at the consumer: a chart the published dataset refuses is not a number Publish will make real, so serving it in the preview was the implementation gap, and the diff makes the spec's own refusal (the engine's, already on the wire for both live faces) real on the one face that lacked it, with the engine's words. The remedy the changeset states (group without a granularity, or bucket a date or datetime field) is the engine's prescription.

Attempts to break it, each read in the cited code:

- A declared type the two readings class differently: none. Both skip undefined and `formula` and pass `date` / `datetime`; the engine classes everything else (`time` → `'time'`, numbers, booleans, and "everything else is read as text") and refuses it; so does the preview. A `json` field keeps the JSON door's words on every face (① item 4).
- A host whose preview judges nothing while the live faces refuse: only a composition without `sourceFieldMeta` (a direct `new AnalyticsService` without the plugin), where every type-reading preview gate already stands down by the same rule (`assertMeasureFieldTypes`, `assertRecordCurrencyGrouped`: "no `sourceFieldMeta`"), and the plugin wires it whenever a `data` service has `getObject`. The documented stand-down; not a finding.
- A served selection the new door refuses: none. A `date` or `datetime` bucket passes on every face (pinned); an undeclared dimension is refused by `assertDimensionFields` first on every face; a relationship path is refused by `assertPreviewJoinsNothing` first.
- The ride-along's rendered SQL: unchanged, per ① item 6, and pinned byte for byte by the echo test's existing cases.
- Refusal precedence on a selection wrong twice: see should-fix 1.

**should-fix 1** (carried, not introduced): refusal precedence against a bad `dateRange` on the preview. On the live faces the strategy reads `dateRangeBounds` before the engine, so a selection carrying both an unrecognised `dateRange` and a non-date bucket answers `ANALYTICS_DATE_RANGE_UNRECOGNIZED`; on the preview the `dateRange` is lowered inside `evaluateAnalyticsQueryOverRows` (`lowerPreviewDateRange`, `preview-evaluator.ts:626-640`), after the whole gate list, so the same selection answers `INVALID_FIELD`. The gap is the preview list's, not this door's: the column-twice door of #28798 already sits in the same position, and both answers are 400 refusals, so the accept set is unaffected. Remedy, for a follow-up on the preview list: lower each `timeDimensions[].dateRange` once before the gate list (or before the two strategy-mirroring doors) and hand the lowered windows to the evaluator. Not a must-fix.

**should-fix 2** (test coverage): the `formula` arm (C3) and the `time` type are unpinned on the preview; the dataset-default-granularity shape of ① item 5 is unpinned too. A fixture declaring a `formula` field (served on every face), a `time` field (refused on every face with "declared time field") and a dataset dimension with `dateGranularity` over a text column would pin the three arms the diff asserts by construction. Not a must-fix.

No must-fix found.

**Check-runs on `80559b2c` at 2026-11-02T05:34:14Z:** 31 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 22 `in_progress`, 0 `failure`. Concluded `success`: `Lint & Repo Gates` (all of `Lint · ESLint`, `PM dispatch-gates`, `docs & code guards`, `CI, release & engine gates`, `repo & tooling gates` and the three scoped jobs), `TypeScript Type Check` (`Type Check · workspace`, `source gates`, `consumer gates`, `debt ledger`), `Build Core`, `Build UI Deps`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Plan Test Core shards`, `Test Core (1/8)`, `Test UI (7/16)`, `Test UI (16/16)`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (the PR run, sharded battery skipped as on every PR run), `Flag docs affected`, `Auto Label`, `filter`. Still running: `Test Core` shards 2 to 8, `Test UI` shards 1 to 6 and 8 to 15, `Type Check UI`. This verdict is on the tree; the landing waits for every required context (`Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Type Check UI` among them) to conclude `success`, as the Tier S rule requires, and a red among them re-opens the record.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · PR #28976 · 2026-11-02T05:37Z

Head-sha: `80559b2cabf41f12e05b97b6b67254eb15774fa5`

**维护者速读(席位终稿)**
- **改了什么**:数据集草稿预览(`previewDrafts: true`)遇到对文本、选项、数字、布尔列做时间分桶时，改为与发布后的查询相同的 400 `INVALID_FIELD`(`groupBy.N.dateGranularity`),逐字段一致。之前预览给出一个 `null` 桶(数字列给出 1970 桶),作者看到的图发布后会被拒。顺带:`/analytics/sql` 回显先读 `dateRange`,与查询的拒绝先后一致。
- **为什么改**:#28852(p3),#28798 dev 的范围外发现;顺带项是 PR #28878 契约复核的 should-fix。
- **风险与回滚**:低。预览门挂在已有预览门列表最后(列重复门之后，与线上面同序),判定与引擎 `classOfDeclaredType` 完全一致(公式/无类型跳过，仅 date/datetime 放行)。无线上面新门禁、无 objectql 改动、无新导出。回滚即 revert。

- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/preview-date-bucket-type.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的**:无。席位按常设授权落地，合并即关 #28852。
- **席位意见**:契约复核 PASS,可落。

### 核对六项
1. **形态**:draft → `main`;`Fixes #28852`,与认领 `6568806407`、派单 `pm-orders/server/order-28852.md` 一致。文件 7 个：申报面内 6 个，另 `packages/client/src/envelope-caller-census.test.ts` 为普查登记(14→15),复核核过。
2. **前提实测**:dev 在 `9a9823d9` 实测，线上两面对四类列全部拒绝，预览全部给桶;base 上红 7/22;消融 C1/C2/C4 各自变红后还原(C3 公式跳过无夹具，复核列为 should-fix)。
3. **门禁**:dev 本地 63 条派生门禁 exit 0,dogfood 全绿(382 文件)。本 head check-runs 读时 39 success、15 skipped、0 失败，余 15 条在跑(Test Core / Test UI 分片等)。合并队列要求全部必需检查 success,有红即撤回本核对。
